question: Who is the recipient of the Abhinandan Saroja National Award 2021 by the National Institute of Indian Classical Dance?
solution:
The correct answer is** **__**Aparna Satheesan**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bharatanatyam/Kuchipudi performer** Aparna Satheesan resides in the **US.**
 
• The renowned **Abhinandan Saroja National Award 2021** has been given to her.
 
• On **November 15th, 2021,** the **National Institute of Indian Classical Dancing** presented the prize in Samarpan.
 
• Both the coveted **Natya Shiromani National Award** and the **Bharata Shastra Nritya Praveena Award** have been awarded to Aparna Satheesan.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Prabhudeva:**

 
 
• Prabhudeva is an **Indian actor, director, producer, and choreographer **of dance.
 
• **Two National Film Awards** for Best Choreography have been given to him.
 
• He received **Padma Shri in 2019 **for his services to dance.
 
 
 
• **Chaya Kumar:**
 
 
• Chaya Kumar is a** Bhangra dancer.**
 
• Chaya Kumar is the **Co-Founder of BFunk.**
 
 
 
• **Shovana Narayan**:
 
 
• An established **Kathak dancer** from India is Shovana Narayan.
 
• She has received the **Padma Shri honor.**
